The only issue I have is a minor one and I don’t think it’s been there forever. I have been using this podcast player for a few months now to regularly listen to my podcasts. It does what it strictly needs to do; it automatically downloads episodes, allows me to access those downloaded files, and keeps track of which episodes I've listened to. However, there are just a lot of small things which, though I can accept, make this app not entirely perfect... It is a pain to manually order a playlist and put it in any order other than when the podcast episodes released. The UI also tries to fit all three menus (podcasts, the episodes of a podcast, and the episode you're listening to) on screen at once on the iPad, meaning they are all a bit squished and none of them get enough space; they should be separate menus, perhaps like Apple Music, where you would look at all your podcasts, click on one and see its episodes, and then see it playing in a tab below, whcih you could click on and expand. I like how it has nearly every podcast, and how they are all free, and how the ads are only banner ads and not audio ads; very respectful. I just have to imagine that this can't possibly be the actual best podcast player; there has to be some player that does all the things this does and doesn't have all these minor issues. In general, I would recommend it, but its claim of being the best podcast player is a strong claim and might not be true.
